# William Gilpin

> William Gilpin is a physicist studying nonlinear dynamics, chaos,
> machine learning, fluid dynamics, and biological systems.

## Research

- [Nonlinear dynamics and chaos](https://www.wgilpin.com/research/nonlinear-dynamics.html)
- [Machine learning for dynamical systems](https://www.wgilpin.com/research/machine-learning-dynamical-systems.html)
- [Time-series analysis](https://www.wgilpin.com/research/time-series-analysis.html)
